playstyle.identity: Vex is an anti-mobility mage who fears enemies who dash near her. Her ultimate lets her dive into the backline and reset on kills.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: periodically fear enemies hit by abilities; dashing near her grants Doom faster. Q fires a wave. W fears around her and shields. E sends shadow that damages and marks. R fires a projectile - hit enemy to dash to them (resets on kill). Anti-dash mage who dives.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Vex spikes at level 6 with her dive ultimate. Luden's scales her burst. She's strong against mobile teams.

passive.name: Doom 'n' Gloom
passive.summary: Periodically fear with abilities; enemies dashing near her speed this up.
passive.details: Vex periodically becomes empowered with Doom - her next ability fears enemies. Enemies dashing near her generate Doom faster and are marked with Gloom for bonus damage.

abilities.name: Mistral Bolt
abilities.summary: Fire a wave that damages and accelerates.
abilities.details: Vex fires a wave of mist that damages enemies and gains speed as it travels.

abilities.name: Personal Space
abilities.summary: Gain a shield and damage/fear enemies around you.
abilities.details: Vex gains a shield and emits a shockwave that damages nearby enemies. Applies Doom fear if available.

abilities.name: Looming Darkness
abilities.summary: Send your shadow to mark and slow enemies.
abilities.details: Vex sends Shadow to a location. It deals damage, slows enemies, and marks them with Gloom.

abilities.name: Shadow Surge
abilities.summary: Fire Shadow; hitting an enemy lets you dash to them. Resets on kill.
abilities.details: Vex fires Shadow forward. If it hits an enemy, she can recast to dash to them, dealing damage on arrival. Resets on champion kills within a few seconds.
